name: ocaml-lsp
description: OCaml Language Server for Claude Code

hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in false|0|no|off) ;; *) command -v ocamllsp >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v opam >/dev/null 2>&1 || opam install -y ocaml-lsp-server || true ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: When ocamllsp is not on PATH, install ocaml-lsp-server into the current opam switch at session start (requires opam; the first build can take minutes). Turn off to manage ocamllsp yourself.
